policy: A source being public or crawlable does not erase copyright, privacy, terms, or attribution requirements. Training eligibility is explicit per source class.

sources.name: Common Crawl
sources.notes: Free bulk access; underlying crawled content can carry separate owner terms.

sources.name: Hugging Face FineWeb
sources.notes: Cleaned/deduplicated English web data derived from Common Crawl.

sources.name: Wikimedia/Wikipedia dumps
sources.notes: Text is generally CC BY-SA; page/media-specific conditions still apply.

sources.name: Stack Exchange public data dump
sources.notes: Use the official dump/API path rather than indiscriminate page scraping.

sources.name: Direct URL ingestion
sources.notes: Robots.txt is checked by default. Private/local network targets are blocked by default.

sources.name: Public Git repositories
sources.notes: Existing reference-source registry remains authoritative for model-source study.
